disposition.note: STRUCTURALLY unreachable in this campaign, and the campaign is A20-only by its own bar. `isNoteForYourselfAvailable` (AbstractDungeon.java:1360-1379) returns false at `ascensionLevel >= 15`, so the row is never ADDED to `specialOneTimeEventList` at all -- collapsed in the engine to `note_for_yourself_available(ascension) == ascension < 15` (event_framework.hpp) under the pinned reference profile. The live captures agree from the other side: every `oracle.specialOneTimeEventList` dump in this report's evidence omits it. A sighting would require a non-A20 capture, which is outside the S2-G2 bar's own scope.

disposition.note: Deliberately unreachable on BOTH sides, and that is now enforced rather than assumed. The engine pins `build_shrine_pool`'s eligibility false in every act (trap 5, `SecretPortalIsPinnedFalseInEveryActIncludingTheBeyond`) because the only gate left is `CardCrawlGame.playtime >= 800.0f` -- nondeterministic wall clock, unrepresentable in a sim whose verification story is determinism in (seed, actions). As of 2026-08-27 the ORACLE mirrors that pin: `patches/OraclePlaytimePinPatch` replaces the one playtime read inside `AbstractDungeon.getShrine` with a helper pinned at 0.0f, so the fork the depth cohorts run against cannot draw it either. Sighting it would mean breaking the pin the gate depends on.
